pages.text: $(o)We carved it to read our own words back to us. Two halves, one reading plate: whoever sets the Almanac down will find the pages open where every pair of hands can see them.$()

Found in the Arcane Safe on the sky island. Set it beside the Portal's libraries and put the Almanac on its left lectern; the right one waits for another book. Right-click a book to read it, or the middle to open the window.
